response.content: Few-shot learning: Few-shot learning (FSL) is a problem setup in machine learning in which a model learns to perform a task, typically classification, from only a small number | Zero-shot learning: earlier concept of one-shot learning in computer vision, in which classification can be learned from only one example. Zero-shot methods generally work | Meta-learning (computer science): Meta-learning is a subfield of machine learning where automatic learning algorithms are applied to metadata about machine learning experiments. As of 2017
